cpu_calibration.procedure: same CPU arithmetic loop; rate set before full app navigation; alternating1x/4x;2repeats

instrumentation.scope: same4livewallscene,5swarmup+8smeasure,on/off/off/on; only optionalGPUqueries differ; other instrumentation remains

api.scope: loopback HTTP, no production clients; 24requests/case; no WAN/network shaping; new urllib connection per request

lifecycle.mode: 10 SPA room/catalog round-trips,4livewalls,1second settle then forcedGC for retained-heap comparison

measurement_protocol.cold_scope: Chrome HTTP cache disabled; OS/driver/media caches not globally reset
measurement_protocol.gpu_timer: Only discard_all_pending_v2 and zero disjoint flag metrics published; early optional desktop timer samples excluded; OS GPU utilization/VRAM remain valid
measurement_protocol.capture: Screenshots occur after timing, OS dedicated VRAM is a subsequent snapshot; screenshot/compositor caching may be retained
measurement_protocol.window_clock: Controlled continuous yaw; GC/CDP collection shifts starting phase slightly; host display pacing variable
